rca of the issue: Bug (b) root cause: in hooks/useShifts.js, the useCloseShift onSuccess calls queryClient.setQueryData(['currentShift'], null) and invalidateQueries(['currentShift']). This hook-level onSuccess runs before the mutate() onSuccess in CloseShiftModal, so currentShift becomes null as soon as the close request returns. The useEffect in Layout.js (lines 88-95: !shiftLoading && !currentShift && user -> setShowOpenShiftModal(true)) then opens OpenShiftModal immediately. Delaying onSuccess/refetchShift in finishClose does not help because the cache is already cleared. For admin it is hidden only because sessionStorage 'adminShiftModalDismissed' is set after the first opening modal is closed or submitted. Repro: log in as cashier with a schedule, open a shift, close it with any amount, then try to click 'Non'. Fix: do not clear or invalidate currentShift in the hook's onSuccess; do it in finishClose instead. Or have Layout track a 'closingReceiptPending' state and skip the auto-open while closedShift is set (e.g. CloseShiftModal calls an onReceiptPending(true/false) prop). Or raise the receipt prompt overlay above the OpenShift dialog and keep the OpenShift dialog non-modal until finishClose.
action_items: HIGH: fix bug (b) for the cashier/pharmacist: the opening modal still opens before the receipt prompt is answered (see RCA: setQueryData null in useCloseShift plus the Layout auto-open useEffect).
Optional: remove expected_amount and difference from the /shifts/close response for non-admins.
